data.description:
## Description

What: New telemetry-collect job in .github/workflows/ci.yml with a permissions block granting contents: write + pull-requests: write (required for resolveReviewThread per community discussion #44650), running after llm-review, NOT gated by [skip ci], and added to .github/required-checks.txt in the same change so branch-protection required-status-checks do not break. The job runs bot-comment-scan.sh then defense-store-to-thread-resolve.sh (which waits up to 60s with 5s polling for the arbiter). The adapter performs a startup permission probe (benign GraphQL query requiring the same scope) and hard-errors on insufficient scope. SC10's six in-session gh-CLI/grep verification checks gate sprint Phase I completion. Why: the GraphQL mutation needs elevated workflow permissions that existing CI jobs do not grant, and the audit requires these be verified live. Scope IN: the CI job + permissions block, required-checks.txt registration, job ordering after llm-review, the SC10 six-check verification contract, the startup permission probe. Scope OUT: the resolution adapter logic itself (draft-5); the dogfooding run (draft-8).


## Done Definitions

- ci.yml declares a telemetry-collect job whose permissions block grants contents: write and pull-requests: write, runs after llm-review, and is registered in .github/required-checks.txt in the same change ← Satisfies: sc-10
- The repo workflow-permission default is write OR the job-level permissions cover the required scope, and a live resolveReviewThread mutation against a test thread on a sprint PR returns a non-error response (token can resolve threads) ← Satisfies: sc-10
- The pr_comments.bot_authors allowlist in .claude/dso-config.conf is populated with a non-empty list including the integrated bots ← Satisfies: sc-10
- An integration test exercises the telemetry-collect job's startup permission probe in a configuration-isolated environment (HOME set to an empty directory, no global git config, no pre-set environment variables) and the probe hard-errors on insufficient scope and passes on sufficient scope ← Satisfies: sc-10

## Considerations

- [Deployment] The job MUST be added to required-checks.txt in the same change as the workflow edit to avoid breaking branch-protection required-status-checks.
- [Live-verified] SC10's token-can-resolve check requires a live resolveReviewThread mutation against a sprint PR thread; this cannot be satisfied by code inspection alone.
- [Permissions] resolveReviewThread needs contents: write AND pull-requests: write per community discussion #44650; the startup probe fails fast rather than absorbing 4xx mid-loop.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a pipeline maintainer, I want a telemetry-collect CI job with contents:write + pull-requests:write permissions wired into ci.yml and required-checks
